content: Hello, I am Beacon Assurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking. What's this about?
First, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
What is your year of birth?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your motor premium has 480.00 past due and is 3 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount today?
That policy was closed months ago, so this premium debt isn't mine. I won't be paying anything today.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
